g.text: FLIGHT PLANNING – QUICK DETERMINATION OF FLIGHT PLAN

svg.text: The following flight planning tables allow the planner to determine trip fuel consumption and trip time required
to cover a given air distance.
• Cruise Mach number: M.80, M.82, M.84, LR
• Descent profile: Cruise Mach number/300 kt/250 kt
• Approach and landing: 240 kg - 6 minute IFR
In the tables, the asterisk (*) means that a step climb of 4,000 feet must be flown to reach the
To obtain a flight plan at optimum cruise level, the highest flight level desired within the flight has
to be selected in the table.
For each degree Celsius above ISA temperature apply fuel correction 0.010 (kg/°C/NM) × ISA (°C) ×

g.text: CORRECTION FOR DEVIATION FROM REFERENCE LANDING WEIGHT

svg.text: The fuel consumption must be corrected when the actual landing weight is different from the reference
If it is lower (or greater) than the reference landing weight, subtract (or add) the value given in the
correction part of the table per 1,000 kg below (or above) the reference landing weight.
